name: GASBOX
description: An on-chain NEO/GAS capsule counter in browse-and-recovery mode. New paid writes remain paused until the fixed-beacon GasBox contract is deployed and this binding is updated.
description_zh: 链上 NEO/GAS 扭蛋柜台当前处于浏览与恢复模式。固定区块信标版 GasBox 合约部署并更新绑定前，新的付费写操作保持暂停。

operation_panel.title: GasBox capsule counter
operation_panel.subtitle: Browse exact machine economics and recover existing player or creator funds. New pulls, publishing, pool top-ups and activation are paused for this deployment.

oracle.description: No off-chain oracle. The replacement source uses a fixed commitIndex+1 block hash, but that artifact is not the currently bound deployment.

vrf.description: The live contract does not use VRF. Paid writes are paused because the bound deployment predates the fixed-beacon replacement source.

aa.description: AA rapid-draw integration is planned but is not the live testnet flow

keeper.description: Settlement is permissionless and the frontend exposes explicit reveal recovery; no production keeper is advertised.
